title: Stuck sync
brief: The shop release is still progressing and the workload has not become ready. Find the failed probe.

checks.question: Which Application matches this incident?
checks.why: Start with the right environment before changing anything.

checks.question: What path does the failing readiness probe request?
checks.hint: Read the pod's Desired manifest and its probe fields.
checks.why: The desired manifest shows the value Argo will keep applying.

truth.cause: The readiness probe points at a nonexistent endpoint
truth.fix: Terminate the stuck operation and commit a valid probe path
